subject: Private chef tasting, transport & accessibility checklist
messages:
From: Kar T. Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@valentech.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@ellisoncatering.com>, sfo-limo@roadrun.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Private chef tasting, transport & accessibility checklist

Team / partners —

Thanks for moving fast on the Palo Alto onsite. We have the executive supper scheduled for Friday 2026-12-18 (private room, 6:30pm seating). Quick checklist and asks so we close logistics this week: 

- Final guest roster: Olivia (ValenTech) + 7 execs, 3 account team (Marissa, Lauren, Dev). I attached the working seating_chart_v1.pdf.
- Dietary/allergies: two vegetarian (one pescatarian), one severe nut allergy (will arrive with EpiPen). Please confirm allergy handling procedures.
- Menu: Marco — need a tasting menu (4 courses) with a vegan substitute option and clear allergen callouts. Please attach proposed_tasting_menu and note any constraints for prep time.
- Transport: we need two vans for pickups from the hotel at 5:45pm and a return at ~9:45pm. RoadRun — confirm vehicle capacity and senior staff IDs for guests.
- Accessibility: one guest uses a folding cane and will need a ground-floor private room and no stairs for path of travel. I attached accessibility_summary.csv for quick reference.
- AV / small stage: none required, but we will need two tabletop mics for brief remarks.
- Budget / billing: charge to Redwood P-card (ending 1234) with an itemized invoice. Include service/linens as separate line items.

Please reply with the following by COB Monday 2026-12-06: proposed menu PDF, confirmation on allergy protocols, transport ETA/vehicle IDs, and final seating chart.

Thanks — I can take point on on-site headcount and final walk-through on the 17th if helpful.

— Kar
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com] [+1 415-555-0172]

[Attachment: seating_chart_v1.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]
[Attachment: accessibility_summary.csv (csv, 4 KB)]

From: Marco Ruiz <marco@ellisoncatering.com>
To: Kar T. Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@valentech.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private chef tasting, transport & accessibility checklist

Kar, Marissa, Olivia —

Thanks, this works. We can do a plated 4-course tasting with the requested vegan and pescatarian options; nut-free station and strict separation protocols will be in place. High-level notes: 

- Sample menu attached: Proposed_Tasting_Menu_v1.pdf. We recommend the order: amuse, seafood course, main (choice of heritage chicken or roasted celeriac), dessert (dairy and dairy-free options).
- Allergen handling: dedicated prep tray, color-coded plating, server-facing tickets noting "NUT ALLERGY". Our kitchen manager (Lydia Chen) will be on site and carries a cross-contamination waiver; we will bring an EpiPen kit and training certificate.
- Staffing: 6 servers + 1 kitchen lead for a private room this size. 
- Timing: 6:30 seating — we allocate 90–100 minutes for the tasting flow.
- Cost: attached sheet has per-head pricing. We can accept net-30 from Redwood; if you prefer P-card we will add 3% card fee (waivable with prior approval).

Attached: Proposed_Tasting_Menu_v1.pdf, Menu_Pricing_Summary.xlsx

Let me know if you want a separate wine pairing or sommelier add-on — we can bring a partner sommelier for flight notes.

— Marco Ruiz
Ellison Catering | marco@ellisoncatering.com | +1 415-555-2468
[Attachment: Proposed_Tasting_Menu_v1.pdf (pdf, 110 KB)]
[Attachment: Menu_Pricing_Summary.xlsx (xlsx, 34 KB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Kar T. Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@ellisoncatering.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@valentech.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private chef tasting, transport & accessibility checklist

Thanks Marco — menu looks great. A few notes and confirmations from the account side: 

- Final guest list (confirmed): Olivia Park, Daniel Kim, Priya Shah, Mateo Alvarez, and four ValenTech senior directors + our 3. Total 11. 
- Accessibility: the guest who uses a cane will be driven directly to the service-floor elevator and escorted to the private room. No stairs in path of travel confirmed with venue.
- Allergy: nut allergy guest is bringing an EpiPen; we requested karthik's plan for server brief before seating.
- Transport: Dev — please book two vans, one with wheelchair-accessible ramp (just in case) and one regular. RoadRun — can you confirm ramp-equipped van availability for 12/18? Pickup window 5:45–6:00pm. Drop-off after event at 9:50pm.

I've attached the seating_chart_v1.pdf (annotated) — note two seats swapped to keep nut-allergic guest away from shared family-style boards.

On billing: we prefer P-card and will route the justifications through finance; Marco, can you reissue the quote with P-card fee waived pending VP approval?

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Account Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: seating_chart_v1.pdf (pdf, 88 KB)]

From: Kar T. Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@ellisoncatering.com>, sfo-limo@roadrun.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@valentech.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private chef tasting, transport & accessibility checklist — Final confirmations

All — final confirmations below for on-site teams. Thanks for the quick turnaround. 

- Menu: Marco confirmed vegan substitution and nut-free prep. Confirmed attachment: Proposed_Tasting_Menu_v1.pdf (final).
- Staffing: 6 servers + kitchen lead + Lydia (kitchen manager) on site.
- Transport: RoadRun confirmed two vans: Van A (capacity 8) reg plate RR-311, Van B (ramp-equipped) reg plate RR-424. Pickup at Hotel Armitage 5:45pm, return 9:50pm. RoadRun ops contact: Maria Liu (ops@roadrun.com).
- Accessibility: ground-floor private room reserved; venue point of contact is Mira Santos (mira@venuepa.com). There are no stairs between hotel arrival and private room.
- Billing: Marco will send an itemized invoice to finance@redwood.com; P-card fee waived.

On the day: Marissa — you'll meet Marco and Lydia at 5:15pm for a short kitchen walk. Lauren — please bring the final guest names on a printed list and note the one nut-allergy explicitly. Dev — please confirm the P-card pre-authorization is in place. Hannah — I'll need you to own the on-site checklist and timeline (arrive 5:00pm).

I'll do a quick pre-event call with Marco and RoadRun tomorrow (12/19) at 10am just to sanity-check load-in. If anything changes, reply-all — otherwise see you Friday.

— Kar
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Menu_Pricing_Summary.xlsx (xlsx, 34 KB)]
